assets.name: fountain
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 32x32-grid pixel art RPG object, to be normalized with nearest-neighbor into a map atlas. Primary request: ONE complete ruined medieval courtyard object, genuinely transparent background, no ground plane, no scenery, no text or grid. Orthographic camera looking north from exactly due south, pitched down 45 degrees, ZERO yaw: front and top surfaces, never a three-quarter isometric camera; horizontal front edges. Chunky deliberate pixel clusters, detailed material readable at 32px tiles. Desaturated olive-gray aged limestone, dark mortar, chipped blocks, restrained yellow-green moss and ivy, brown rotten wood, matching an abandoned war-damaged medieval stone town. Unmaintained, solemn, decayed; no glowing magic, no characters, no modern details, no cast shadow outside silhouette. Center whole object with transparent padding; do not crop. Subject: a large BROKEN OCTAGONAL CIVIC FOUNTAIN with a partly destroyed armored guardian statue at its center. Final footprint roughly 8 tiles wide and 8 tiles tall, 256x256. Tall chipped pedestal, statue missing head and one arm, exposed rough fractures, shallow stagnant dark teal water and rubble inside a cracked broad basin; a missing chunk from the front-right basin rim. Heavy layered stone basin rim visible from front, convincing height, substantial strong silhouette. The ruin was once magnificent but is now neglected and mossy. Single isolated complete object.
